mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, express_id AS expressId, user_id AS userId, pickup_code AS pickupCode, operator_id AS operatorId, pickup_method AS pickupMethod, DATE_FORMAT(pickup_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS pickupTime, remark AS remark, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime FROM pickup_record WHERE express_id = #{expressId} ORDER BY pickup_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pickup_record ( express_id, user_id, pickup_code, operator_id, pickup_method, pickup_time, remark, create_time ) VALUES ( #{expressId}, #{userId}, #{pickupCode}, #{operatorId}, #{pickupMethod}, #{pickupTime}, #{remark}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pickup_time >= CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pickup_time >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS monthCount, COUNT(*) AS totalCount FROM pickup_record WHERE operator_id = #{userId}
